references.cited_as: U.S. Food and Drug Administration. Warning Letter 320-26-58 to Purolea Cosmetics Lab. April 2, 2026. CDER.
references.version_or_date: Letter dated April 2, 2026; MARCS-CMS 722591; issued by CDER; recipient Ms. Maria N. Mattina, Purolea Cosmetics Lab, 12782 Currie Ct., Livonia, MI 48150-1109
references.retrieved_with: WebFetch of official fda.gov page (direct curl blocked by session proxy); quotes returned in consecutive pieces
references.notes: The letter does not describe itself as FDA's first AI-related warning letter, and no FDA press statement about it was found (fda.gov-restricted searches, Nov 15, 2026). 'First' claims removed from title, H1, meta and body; trade press calls it the first, but those are not FDA sources. The letter contains no requirement that QU review of AI output be 'documented'; that wording was removed. Some quoted sentences contain (b)(4) redactions between pieces in FDA's text.

claims.text: Issued April 2, 2026 by CDER as Warning Letter 320-26-58 to Purolea Cosmetics Lab
claims.quote: Warning Letter 320-26-58 ... Purolea Cosmetics Lab - 722591 - 04/02/2026

claims.text: Letter contains a section headed 'Inappropriate Use of Artificial Intelligence in Pharmaceutical Manufacturing'
claims.quote: Inappropriate Use of Artificial Intelligence in Pharmaceutical Manufacturing

claims.text: Firm told investigators it used AI agents to comply with FDA regulations and used AI to create specifications, procedures and master production or control records
claims.quote: you stated to FDA investigators that you utilized artificial intelligence (AI) agents to help your firm comply with FDA regulations. Specifically, you used AI to create drug product specifications, procedures, and master production or control records

claims.text: Quoted requirement to review AI-generated documents; failure is a violation of 21 CFR 211.22(c) (consecutive sentences)
claims.quote: If you use AI as an aid in document creation, you must review the AI generated documents to ensure they were accurate and actually compliant with CGMP. Your failure to do so is a violation of 21 CFR 211.22(c).

claims.text: Overreliance on AI documented; no process validation before distribution as required by 21 CFR 211.100
claims.quote: Overreliance on artificial intelligence for your drug manufacturing operations was also documented during the inspection. For example, the FDA investigators found that you had not conducted process validation prior to distribution

claims.text: Firm said it was not aware of the requirement because the AI agent never told it
claims.quote: You replied that you were not aware of the legal requirement, as the AI agent you used never told you it was required.

claims.text: If production resumes, AI output must be reviewed and cleared by an authorized human representative of the QU per FD&C Act 501(a)(2)(B)
claims.quote: any output or recommendations from an AI agent must be reviewed and cleared by an authorized human representative of your firm's QU in accordance with section 501(a)(2)(B) of the FD&C Act.

claims.text: Facility in Livonia, Michigan, inspected October 28 to 30, 2025
claims.quote: Purolea Cosmetics Lab, FEI 3011669383, at 12782 Currie Ct., Livonia, from October 28 to 30, 2025.

claims.text: Insanitary conditions: insects, filth, leaves and clutter
claims.quote: our investigator observed the presence of insects, filth, leaves, and clutter in several areas within your facility.

claims.text: Finished homeopathic products released without microbiological testing; 21 CFR 211.165(b)
claims.quote: Your firm released your finished homeopathic drug products without testing for microbiological attributes ... required to be free of objectionable microorganisms (21 CFR 211.165(b)

claims.text: Failure to adequately test high-risk incoming components for identity; 21 CFR 211.84(d)
claims.quote: You failed to adequately test your incoming components at high risk of contamination for identity before using them ... (21 CFR 211.84(d)(1) and 211.84(d)(2) and 211.84(d)(6)).

claims.text: Quality control unit failures cited under 21 CFR 211.22
claims.quote: Your firm's quality control unit failed to exercise its responsibility to ensure drug products manufactured are in compliance with CGMP ... (21 CFR 211.22).

claims.text: Products including Dermveda shingles and genital herpes relief products are unapproved new drugs
claims.quote: including "Dermveda Extra Strength Shingles Relief" and "Dermveda Extra Strength Ultra Genital Herpes Relief." ... Accordingly, these products are unapproved new drugs.

claims.text: FDA recognizes the firm has ceased drug production
claims.quote: We recognize that you have ceased drug production.

claims.text: FDA asked for written response within 15 working days, notification before resuming, and a 21 CFR 211.34 consultant six-system audit
claims.quote: respond to this office in writing within 15 working days ... that you will notify this office prior to resuming your drug manufacturing operations ... engage a consultant qualified as set forth in 21 CFR 211.34 ... comprehensive six-system audit

claims.text: Letter addresses AI 'as an aid in document creation' and objects to documents no one reviewed (table row 1, telehealth intro)
claims.quote: If you use AI as an aid in document creation, you must review the AI generated documents to ensure they were accurate
